events.factual_description: Roulette presents Terre Thaemlitz on Sunday, November 15, 2026, as part of DURATIONS Festival. Doors are at 19:00 and the event begins at 20:00. Roulette says Thaemlitz will perform a solo-piano composition live, followed by a conversation with Triple Canopy contributing editor Ciarán Finlayson about Thaemlitz's music and criticism. The event is presented in collaboration with Triple Canopy. Roulette identifies DURATIONS as a seven-day multidisciplinary festival spanning Public Records, Pioneer Works, Roulette, and the Whitney Museum of American Art. Roulette lists a $42.23 advance ticket. Thaemlitz's official Comatonse performance schedule independently lists November 13-15 piano solo and DJ appearances at DURATIONS Festival in New York and notes a deliberate post-2023 reduction to a small number of live appearances each year.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is not Thaemlitz's reputation as DJ Sprinkles. Roulette puts piano at the center, then immediately turns the performance into a conversation about the ideas surrounding the music. That pairing exposes a less routine side of an artist whose live schedule is deliberately sparse: instrumental composition first, criticism and cultural argument second, all inside a festival built to move between sound, talks, and audiovisual work.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play that weekend, actively make room for Sunday night at Roulette. For a corridor trip, pair it with another strong reason to be in the city rather than making the entire journey hinge on one performance.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho no es la reputación de Thaemlitz como DJ Sprinkles. Roulette pone al piano en el centro y, enseguida, convierte la función en una conversación sobre las ideas que rodean esa música. La combinación deja ver un costado menos rutinario de un artista con una agenda en vivo deliberadamente escasa: primero composición instrumental; después crítica y discusión cultural, dentro de un festival diseñado para cruzar sonido, conversaciones y trabajo audiovisual.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego ese fin de semana, le haría espacio activamente al domingo por la noche en Roulette. Para un viaje por el corredor, la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para estar en la ciudad en vez de hacer que todo el trayecto dependa de una sola función.
